claim_ceiling: The static BD characteristic threshold is exact within the convention-matched static spherical Lovelock sector analysis. It does not prove strong hyperbolicity of any specified evolution gauge, does not classify rotating backgrounds, and does not establish mode stability or EFT validity.

qualification_layers.physical_characteristic_sector_signature: Gauge-invariant sector effective metrics where symmetry permits; static BD result is an exact control.
qualification_layers.gauge_fixed_strong_hyperbolicity: A specified gauge-fixed first-order evolution system must have real speeds and a complete uniformly controlled eigenbasis; formulation-dependent.
qualification_layers.mode_stability: Separate spectral stability problem, only after the evolution problem is sufficiently well posed.
